name: walk_two_tables_until_flag
description: Walks two byte tables in parallel from a fixed offset, saving each byte around a call to a helper, restoring it afterwards, and repeating until the second helper returns one. The helpers only merge small constants into a data register, so the saved bytes are preserved while the loop checks the flag.

name: test_d3_word_threshold
description: Compares the low word of data register D3 with 200 and returns in both outcomes, so the comparison has no visible effect in the recovered code.

name: clear_1360_byte_buffer
description: Zeroes a block of 1360 bytes starting at a fixed buffer, one byte per pass. Its one helper merges zero into D3 and does not affect the clearing loop.

name: wait_vertical_beam_bit_toggle
description: Polls one bit of the vertical beam position register until it is set, then polls until it clears, so it returns after one full toggle of that bit. The routine returns zero and does no other work.
